Estoril Praia season | website = {{URL|http://www.estorilpraia.pt/}} | pattern_la1 = _estorilpraia2526h | pattern_b1 = _estorilpraia2526h | pattern_ra1 = _estorilpraia2526h | pattern_sh1 = _estorilpraia2526h | pattern_so1 = | leftarm1 = FFE000 | body1 = FFE000 | rightarm1 = FFE000 | shorts1 = 0033FF | socks1 = 0033FF | pattern_la2 = _estorilpraia2526a | pattern_b2 = _estorilpraia2526a | pattern_ra2 = _estorilpraia2526a | pattern_sh2 = _estorilpraia2526a | leftarm2 = FFFFFF | body2 = FFFFFF | rightarm2 = FFFFFF | shorts2 = FFFFFF | socks2 = FFFFFF | pattern_la3 = | pattern_b3 = | pattern_ra3 = | pattern_sh3 = | leftarm3 = | body3 = | rightarm3 = | shorts3 = | socks3 = }} '''Grupo Desportivo Estoril Praia''' ({{IPA|pt|ɨʃtuˈɾil ˈpɾajɐ}}), commonly known as '''Estoril''', is a Portuguese professional [[sports club]] from [[Estoril]], Cascais, Lisbon. Founded on 17 May 1939,{{cite news|url=http://gdestorilpraia.net/principal_ind.html|title=Grupo Desportivo Estoril Praia|publisher=gdestorilpraia.net|language=pt|date=12 July 2012|access-date=12 July 2012|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20121020022314/http://www.gdestorilpraia.net/principal_ind.html|archive-date=20 October 2012|url-status=dead}} its [[Association football|football]] team currently plays in [[Primeira Liga]] and hold home games at the [[Estádio António Coimbra da Mota]], with a seating capacity of 5,094. As a sports club, Estoril has departments for football, [[futsal]] and [[basketball]]. Since the club's establishment, the senior football team has won nine secondary trophies, with the most recent being the [[2011–12 Liga de Honra]].{{citation needed|date=March 2025}} As a result, some personnel of the club received awards in relation to their performances in the 2011–12 season, of which include [[Licá]], who won the [[LPFP Awards#Liga de Honra Awards|LPFP Liga de Honra Player of the Year]], [[Vagner da Silva|Vagner]], who won the [[LPFP Awards#Liga de Honra Awards|LPFP Liga de Honra Goalkeeper of the Year]], and [[Marco Silva]], who won the [[LPFP Awards#Liga de Honra Awards|LPFP Liga de Honra Coach of the Year]].{{cite web | url= http://www.lpfp.pt/noticias/Pages/Pr%C3%A9miosOficiaisosvencedores.aspx | title= Vencedores dos Prémios Oficiais | trans-title= Winners of the official awards | publisher= [[Portuguese League for Professional Football|LPFP]] | language= pt | date= 6 July 2012 | access-date= 7 July 2012 | archive-date= 16 December 2019 | archive-url= https://web.archive.org/web/20191216144557/http://www.lpfp.pt/noticias/Pages/Pr%C3%A9miosOficiaisosvencedores.aspx | url-status= dead }}{{cite web | url= http://www.abola.pt/nnh/ver.aspx?id=340397 | title= Licá eleito o melhor jogador da Liga de Honra 2011/2012 | trans-title= Licá named the player of the Liga de Honra 2011/2012 | publisher= [[A Bola]] | language= pt | date= 5 July 2012 | access-date= 6 July 2012 | archive-url= https://web.archive.org/web/20140506115102/http://www.abola.pt/nnh/ver.aspx?id=340397 | archive-date= 6 May 2014 | url-status= dead }}"}}
